_comment: Lectern's watch list. Every company here is checked on every run REGARDLESS of whether it has an education, education-advocate, or AI-advocate role today. Professor Bear's rule, 2026-09-26: 'AI grows so fast that the agent should check the company regardless if they have explicit educational roles or educational advocate roles or AI advocate roles. Because it's likely these companies are going to create those roles if they don't have them now. So the agent should check.' A company with zero matches is a company being watched, not a company to drop. Counts below are from the 2026-09-26 probe and are a snapshot, not a contract. Companies under 'unreachable' have no ATS recorded: the probe found no board on the three APIs Lectern reads, and the ATS they actually use has not been verified. Nothing is guessed — see ATS.md. 2026-09-26 (second pass): added Stripe, GitLab, Twilio, Netlify (Greenhouse) and Supabase (Ashby) from Professor Bear's list of companies that hire designer/developer/creator advocates. IMPORTANT: a company in 'unreachable' is NOT a company with no demand — it is a company Lectern cannot read. Google is the clearest case and is documented with a manual check.

boards.why_watched: Beneficial Deployments is hiring education roles now: Developer Education Lead (Claude Platform), Lead Technical Instructor, Head of Technical Training, Full Stack Engineer (Education Labs). Claude for Education launched with Northeastern.
Figma Education is an acquisition funnel; Designer Advocate is the Assignment 2 dream job.
Adjacent audience, no education push yet. Zero matches today. NOTE: the slug is their old company name, RealtimeBoard.

boards.why_watched: A dedicated ChatGPT Education & Learning product team; Tech Lead Manager (Education), Account Director (Higher Education), Academic Research Partnerships. ChatGPT Edu is the university-license wedge. Largest board in the set.
Notion for Education is a student-magnet freemium play and Notion AI already ships. Technical Education Specialist and Developer Advocate both open.

removed._comment: Removed from the watch list on 2026-10-18 at Professor Bear's word ('we can remove Stripe and Writer for now'). The 2026-09-26 rule was to watch every company whatever it posts; this is a deliberate exception. His reason, corrected the same day: not that these companies or their products are bad or not useful, but that he does not see them as directly applicable to transformative, AI-driven improvement of education. Not a finding about either company. Their last counts are kept so the removal is visible. 2026-10-19: Replit removed at his word ("let's remove Replit from the job search"; "it's not really educational AI, it's just AI"), the same kind of deliberate exception. 2026-10-20: Vercel, Webflow, Airtable, GitLab, Twilio, Netlify, Jasper AI and Supabase removed at his word, for the same kind of reason as Replit: software products, not educational AI for institutions or universities. 2026-10-20: HubSpot removed at his word. Miro was considered the same day and kept for now: he wants to research it first.

Writer.reason: not directly applicable to transformative, AI-driven improvement of education (not a judgment that it is a bad tool; he first said he did not think writing-AI tools were good, then clarified)

Not a finding about the company beyond that judgment.
